title: Comfort Club Member Relief on a Pulled-Forward Home Comfort Financing Installment
content:
*Member benefit note — Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements and Home Comfort Financing installments.*

The pull-forward member relief is 50 percent when the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active and has run at least 5 consecutive terms, 25 percent when that agreement is active and has run fewer than 5 consecutive terms, and zero when the borrower holds no active Comfort Club agreement.

The relief acts on the pulled-forward share of the next installment: that share — the monthly payment multiplied by the pull-forward share — is then reduced once by the pull-forward reliefs added together; the reliefs never act one after another. The installment still owed is not reduced by it.

| Comfort Club agreement | Pull-forward member relief |
|---|---|
| active, at least 5 consecutive terms | 50 percent |
| active, fewer than 5 consecutive terms | 25 percent |
| none active | zero |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Monthly payment $238.47; pull-forward share 100 percent; the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active in its 6th consecutive term, and no other pull-forward relief applies. Pulled-forward share: $238.47 multiplied by 100 and divided by 100, then multiplied by 50 and divided by 100: $119.235. Where nothing is pulled forward, the relief has nothing to act on.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the relief change when the agreement has exactly 5 consecutive terms?** At exactly 5 the agreement has run at least 5 terms: 50 percent.

**The member's agreement has lapsed.** No active agreement: zero.
